# Cressida Lindsay

## Overview

- **Age:** Eighteen years old in Volume 5  <sub>[v5 c4 P48](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0048)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v3 c4 P21](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0021)</sub>
- **Status:** Engaged  <sub>[v5 c27 P0](../source/v05-c27.md#nw-v05-c27-p0000)</sub>
- **Origin:** Harborough, Nova Scotia  <sub>[v3 c4 P31](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0031)</sub>
- **Role:** University student at Wexcombe College  <sub>[v3 c4 P19](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0019), [v3 c4 P46](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0046)</sub>
- **Titles:** Cressy  <sub>[v3 c4 P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Cressy  <sub>[v3 c4 P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028)</sub>

## Appearance

Cressida is a strikingly attractive girl with brown, satiny hair and dark, plush, brown eyes beneath black eyebrows, accompanied by an asymmetrical mouth with very white teeth. Her complexion is fair and rosy, and she possesses a lively, dimpled face and figure that grows plumper as she ages. She dresses with extreme elegance, frequently adorning her hair with ribbon bows.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P20](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0020), [v3 c4 P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028), [v3 c4 P39](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0039), [v3 c13 P8](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0008), [v3 c13 P10](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0010), [v3 c26 P7](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0007)_

## Personality

Cressida is extremely talkative, cheerful, and playfully dramatic, admitting openly to her own indecisiveness and frivolous nature. She loves luxury, pretty clothes, and the company of numerous suitors, though she is incapable of harboring long-term malice or snobbery. Behind her flirtatious and lighthearted demeanor lies a sweet, loyal, and warm-hearted friend who values her close relationships.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P27](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0027), [v3 c4 P40](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0040), [v3 c4 P50](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0050), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c5 P3](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0003), [v3 c20 P7](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0007)_

- Earn a university degree at Wexcombe College  <sub>[v3 c4 P46](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0046)</sub>

## History

Cressida met Nell Harcourt and Honora Hollis in Old St. John's Cemetery during their first days at Wexcombe College, quickly becoming inseparable friends. She joined Nell, Honora, and Mabel Colby in renting Tabby's Place, where she adapted cheerfully to house chores and budgeting despite her wealthy background. During a summer stay at Prospect Point, she met a plain theology student, Ezra Hale, falling deeply in love with him. After turning down her former suitors, Hector and Orlando, she accepted Ezra's marriage proposal during her final year at college, graduating with Honors in Mathematics and planning a wedding for the following summer.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P18](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0018), [v3 c4 P37](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0037), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c10 P57](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0057), [v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 c24 P21](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0021), [v3 c26 P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), [v3 c27 P19](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0019), [v3 c37 P2](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0002)_

- Grew up in a wealthy family at the historic Mount Holly estate in Harborough, Nova Scotia  <sub>[v3 c4 P31](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0031), [v3 c17 P11](../source/v03-c17.md#nw-v03-c17-p0011), [v3 c29 P11](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0011)</sub>
